name: How long does a typical bathroom renovation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom renovation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a bathroom renovation depends on its complexity. A basic remodel involving cosmetic changes like painting, new fixtures, and flooring might take 2-3 weeks. A more extensive renovation, including layout changes, plumbing, or electrical work, can extend to 4-8 weeks or longer. Unexpected issues like structural problems or material delays can also affect the schedule. We provide a detailed project timeline before starting work.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical bathroom renovation can take 2-3 weeks for minor updates or 4-8 weeks for more extensive remodels, depending on the scope of work.
